openmontage.preserved: All other2168files retain original bytes and executable permission semantics, including code, Skills, guides, tests, runtime templates/fonts/icons, license and dependency inputs. No hardlink deduplication.
openmontage.provenance: recipes/openmontage/upstream/source-bundle.json includes each retained file SHA256/bytes/mode; original archive URL/SHA and exact omitted file list are separate from the shipped bundle hash.
openmontage.defaultBuild: Source archive is supplied in the context, SHA-verified and extracted without downloading the OpenMontage repository. No build-downloads.json or GitHub archive fetch instruction in the new default recipe.
openmontage.dependencyCache: pip/Remotion/HyperFrames installation runs before integration overlays, Skills and provenance are copied. Dependency inputs still invalidate that layer; source groups remain applied to package installation.
openmontage.reproduction: scripts/package_openmontage_source.py reads an original local archive with its exact original SHA, rejects unsafe/linked/duplicate entries and occupied outputs, and deterministically reproduces the bundle plus provenance.
openmontage.standaloneAndSize: The complete exported context remains below the32MiB import limit and supports normal standalone docker build. The bundle is shipped beside the executable in recipes/, not embedded into the Go binary.
openmontage.licensing: Original AGPL license and all retained source files accompany the bundle; local and root third-party notices identify omissions and archive provenance.

legacyArchiveDownloads.binding: Original URL SHA256 plus expected archive SHA256; changing selected mirror cannot append to another URL partial.
legacyArchiveDownloads.resume: Range with validated offsets/total; strong ETag or Last-Modified also sends If-Range. Same-URL pinned-SHA transfers without validators remain subject to full final SHA verification.
legacyArchiveDownloads.fallback: HTTP200 truncates/restarts safely. Invalid206/416, oversized or mixed/wrong bytes never become usable cache.
legacyArchiveDownloads.commit: Only a complete file with expected SHA256 is atomically promoted. Cancellation/transport failures may retain recoverable partials; integrity failures purge them.

legacyArchiveDownloads.progress: Bytes/total/percentage/rate and resume offset in the existing bounded/redacted build log.
